PARK CITY FORECAST

6am(1/5)-6pm: Snow showers linger through 4pm. Expect slush in lower Parleys/Park City, up to 1” of snow at Parleys/Mayflower summits, 1-3″ road snow near Empire Pass.

6pm (1/5) – 6am (1/6): Likely dry. Icy spots possible as temperatures drop overnight.
